items.title: Tesla Roadster: The Flying Car (Kind Of)
points: Tesla redesigned the Roadster using compressed-air thrusters (pressurized gas propulsion system) inspired by SpaceX technology, enabling short vertical leaps rather than sustained flight.
The vehicle is not intended for long-haul flying but has generated significant public excitement following the demonstration.
Features include performance upgrades and futuristic design elements completing Elon Musk's vision of 'the future should look like the future.'

items.title: Dodo De-extinction Progress
points: Colossal Biosciences reports 95% of the dodo genome has been sequenced, with AI platforms narrowing focus to ~2,300 genetic targets linked to the bird's distinctive beak.
The species, extinct since the 1600s due to human settlement and introduced rats in Mauritius, could be reintroduced to its native habitat.
No hatch date has been announced, but the company maintains the project is on track.

items.title: Cancer Drug RYZ101 Shows Promise
points: Bristol Myers Squibb's RYZ101 succeeded in Phase 3 trials for neuroendocrine tumors (rare cancers affecting ~18,000 Americans annually).
The drug functions as a targeted therapy, latching onto tumor cells and delivering short-range radiation that damages their DNA.
Specific efficacy numbers have not yet been disclosed, but results offer hope to patients with limited medical alternatives.

items.title: Earth's Magnetism May Affect Lifespan
points: University of Nottingham research showed fruit flies shielded from nearly all Earth's magnetic field lived approximately 20% longer than control groups.
The mechanism remains unknown, and whether the effect applies to humans is still undetermined.
Findings could inform understanding of how long-term space travel beyond Earth's magnetic field may impact astronaut health and longevity.

Colossal Biosciences has filled 95% of the dodo bird's genome and narrowed genetic targets to ~2,300, claiming to be on track for eventual resurrection and reintroduction to Mauritius.
Bristol Myers Squibb's cancer drug RYZ101 hit its Phase 3 trial goal for rare neuroendocrine tumors, using targeted radiation delivery to break down tumor DNA in patients with few treatment options.

University of Nottingham scientists found fruit flies lived ~20% longer when shielded from Earth's magnetic field, suggesting a hidden force may influence lifespan and informing future astronaut health studies.
